verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a broad public REST API. It covers API credentials with configurable permissions, customer screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, case and alert remediation via API, exports, audit trails, transactions, and role endpoints. Rate-limit headers, versioning policy, a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema are also documented. A probe retrieved and parsed the OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources; the 404s on standard OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives at a different URL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of authenticated API operations (the probe was documentation retrieval only).
